Base Appearance

General

New
Those who harbor greed are not welcome within these gates!
Cookie Info & Loading
Do not covet that which is sweet, for it leads Cookies astray. Cease seeking the easy path, for never does it lead to enlightenment.
What remains when all has crumbled to dust? Do not pursue vanity, for never does it lead to enlightenment.
My training will not cease until my sugar sweat erodes through the rocks. I have sworn that my strength will never be used for personal gain.
Approach training with a heart of solid stone. Break free from attachment and advance unburdened!
I would allow my fists to shatter if it meant becoming stronger.
Tired
There's no end to training...

Lobby

Daily Reward
Let each new day bring you a step closer to enlightenment.
Tap
One must first accept their own struggles before they can truly understand the pain of living beings. I first came to the Halite Monastery following my Master.
Trivial feelings are restricted to this realm. I shall not be worn down nor broken by the passage of time.
The arrogance needed to believe one's training may become(sic) to an end will make all previous training for naught. The monks regularly polished me during my time at the armory.
Put down your weapons and steady your heart before stepping through the gates. Even if so much time passes these boulders are reduced to sand I shall not forget my past mistakes.
Have you heard the Halite Bell echoing within the Monastery at dawn? Do not be deceived by enemies standing directly in sight.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Boundless Great Ramparts Lobby Will these ramparts truly be enough to stop the Umbral Pact?
When placed in the Halite Monastery of the Awakened Path Lobby I have spent ages upon this land, and yet even I am far from true enlightenment...
When placed in a Lobby with Bamboo Blade Cookie Was I not the only one of us unable to break free from the past?
When placed in a Lobby with Nimbus Cake Cookie If there is something you wish to protect with your life, you must be prepared to let your dough shatter.
Gift
Neutral I shall not covet unnecessary wealth or possessions.
Given Mountain Ridge Halite I shall steel my resolve by reminiscing the past when I was breaking holes through megaliths...
Given Royal Golden Dough The Halite Monastery was made in gold to openly express our reverence of the sun.

Cookie Trials

Trial Info
Declare what brings you to the Halite Monastery. One is not able to protect everything through strength alone.
Pray not for yourself, but for all living beings. If your only motivation is power, leave these grounds.
Simply swinging your fists is not what brings victory. Something must have brought your here.
New Cookie Cup End
You have attained enlightenment. You may descend the mountain.

 Forged in the Mountain

Reused quotes are marked with an asterisk.

General

Cookie Info & Loading
Training is the act of honing both the dough and the mind. I fight to protect and to protect alone.
I have chiseled away all meaningless thoughts. Witness the skills I have polished to gem-like perfection.
Do not tolerate vanity, for never does it lead to enlightenment. What remains when all has crumbled to dust?*
Fear not breaking free from the fetters of self-righteousness. Cease seeking the easy path, for never does it lead to enlightenment.*
I cannot allow it to end here. Break free from attachment and advance unburdened!*
Tired
I've failed to chisel away... all my obstinacy....

Lobby

Daily Reward
If you do not neglect your training you will one day come upon enlightenment.
Tap
Your name holds no value in these lands. Your skills must speak for themselves. Have you come to train?
Each Cookie requires different training. I shall continue to hone myself until we may rid these lands of all forms of darkness.
The Halite Monastery welcomes not those who simply try to flatter with polished words. My appearance is not due to a carefully honed skill... But the result of breaking away from my shameful past.
Have you already completed training upon Great Ramparts? Discern what it is you must cut away.
Blindly challenging your dough does naught but lead to spoil. The monks are training. Lower your voices.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Boundless Great Ramparts Lobby Just as these ramparts are endless, so is a martial artist's training.
When placed in the Halite Monastery of the Awakened Path Lobby This is the land upon which I chiseled away all that was unnecessary within myself.
When placed in a Lobby with  Fists of the Apex Ascendant Have you achieved a state of harmony without imperfection through careful honing of your dough and mind?
When placed in a Lobby with  Mantle of the Skyborne Clan Never forget your desire to protect Cookies or your clan.
Gift
Neutral It is meaningless.
Given Mountain Ridge Halite I shall continue forward to hone my skills.
Given Royal Golden Dough It shines with the light of a carefully polished gem.
